name: Kiaasa Retail Ltd
title: Kiaasa Retail Ltd - 544711 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Kiaasa is a small SME-listed ethnic-wear EBO roll-out story with FY26 revenue of Rs134.63 cr and EBITDA margin of 17.8%, but no supply-side evidence (capacity, utilisation, pricing) and a 35% revenue CAGR vision to FY30 that management did not tie to capex.

capex.quote: the objective is to open around 66 stores in next two years. So that 46 crore that you see over here is only for opening the store and for Capex and inventory both.

triggers.label: 66 stores funded by IPO, 46 cr
triggers.quote: the objective is to open around 66 stores in next two years

triggers.label: Repeated audio/question evasion
triggers.quote: Om Prakash: Not audible. There is some issue.

guidance.quote: With a clear objective to expand our network to 250 stores by 2028

guidance.value: 35% to FY30 (confirmed by management as 'almost' with 45% EBITDA CAGR)

guidance.quote: we see in the next couple of years we'll be growing on this by 10% almost, 10 to 12%
We are like hoping that 8 to 10% of the contribution in Divas category
we have to have around 1200 to 1500 size of the stores

red_flags.label: Margin jump unexplained; EBITDA margin 13-14% to 17-18% attributed to sourcing with no numbers
red_flags.quote: it is basically because we have improved our sourcing efficiencies

red_flags.label: Store capex ~24-25 lakh and 46 cr funding unverified; 35% CAGR not supported by capex plan beyond 66 stores
red_flags.quote: So that 46 crore that you see over here is only for opening the store

red_flags.label: Revenue grew 11.2% in FY26 vs 35% CAGR vision
red_flags.quote: Our revenue grew by 11.2% in FY26
